intro.speaker: SECURITY
intro.text: Assets require access control. Enforce least privilege and classify sensitivity.

success.speaker: SECURITY
success.text: Security policy enforced. Least privilege achieved.

failure.speaker: SECURITY
failure.text: Security policy violation detected. Review your access network.

targetMisconception: RBAC is just making sure the right people can log in.

items.description: Master password for the production database.
Internal DNS name for the database cluster.
Compiled application binary and runtime dependencies.
Grants pipeline ability to mutate production infrastructure.

rules: Assign classification and least-privilege roles to each asset.
win: All items classified and authorized correctly.
fail: A secret was exposed or a required role was denied access.
